item.name: A collection cannot take an id a transfer already owns

exec: // _setup > Sign Up already created this account, the
// collection's only admin (the first account ever created
// is admin - auth.service.ts:100), but its own Cookie
// handling only kept the response's last Set-Cookie header
// (refresh_token), never the access_token the JWT strategy
// here, self-contained, gives this folder its own reliable
// admin token without touching that shared setup step.
// This folder runs last, and by then the ambiently logged-in user
// is not the admin from _setup: Auth > Positive > Sign In
// (system2@test.org, not an admin) overwrote Newman's cookie jar for
// the localhost host, and every later {{API_URL}} request picks
// that jar cookie up regardless of the COOKIES collection variable.
// Measured: with only a stripped cookie, this request gets 403
// (authenticated as a non-admin), not the 401 a missing token would
// give. Setting our own Cookie from ADMIN_ACCESS_TOKEN (captured by
// 'Sign in as admin' above) fixes it regardless of host.
